title: The DM page and the chat dock share one thread component

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: components/frequency/members/messages/dm-thread.tsx and components/messages/thread.tsx both render a DM thread with their own typing, send and scroll logic, so the composer upgrade in LIVE-2525 would land twice. Fix: one component, two placements.

DONE 2026-11-24: one DM thread, two looks. components/messages/use-dm-thread.ts owns everything a DM does (the realtime insert with the optimistic echo swap, the read mark, typing, the pinned scroller, the optimistic send with the words handed back on a refused send). The Messages page (FqDmThread) and the dock (MessageThread) keep only their own box and markup. Side effect: a DM read in the dock now moves the read mark, which only the page did before.
